source: Golden Theme variant tournament against Calm Enough For Your Chaos first principles and creator shareability feedback.
selector_verdict: Winner is deliberately partner-tag first: the hook names a universal couple behavior, Aachu's proof is the not-hungry to best-bite switch, Zuv's role is active knowing care, and the final line is sendable without private context.
calm_enough_for_chaos_alignment: Preserves the gold carousel machine: universal anti-ideal -> expressive Aachu proof -> Zuv's calm active care -> tender acceptance thesis, while using food as a behavioral receipt.

candidates.name: He Married I'm Not Hungry
candidates.universal_truth: Some people say they do not want food, then become very committed to the best bite.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's not-hungry face lasts exactly until Zuv's plate arrives.
candidates.concrete_proof: One bite, then the best bite, then half the plate quietly becoming hers.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv does not tease her into admitting it; he orders extra like he already knows the ending.

candidates.name: Bas Ek Bite
candidates.universal_truth: Bas ek bite is rarely one bite in love.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu says the smallest possible request with the most obvious food-interest face.
candidates.concrete_proof: The fork travels from one polite bite to the best part of Zuv's plate.
candidates.zuv_role: He slides the plate closer without making her perform the whole confession.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love leaves room on the plate.

candidates.name: The Extra Plate
candidates.universal_truth: The right person starts ordering for the version of you that will be hungry in five minutes.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's no-thank-you softens the moment the food appears.
candidates.concrete_proof: Two plates on the table even though only one person claimed hunger.
candidates.zuv_role: He quietly creates abundance before she has to reverse her answer.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love makes space for the maybe.

candidates.name: Not Hungry Until Yours Arrives
candidates.universal_truth: Some people are not hungry until your plate looks better than their decision.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's denial becomes mischief as soon as Zuv starts eating.
candidates.concrete_proof: Her fork entering the frame while his hand pauses mid-bite.
candidates.zuv_role: He laughs softly and lets the bite become a ritual instead of a fight.

candidates.name: Plate Scorekeeping
candidates.universal_truth: Food math is not real math when love is involved.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu insists it was only one bite with deeply unconvincing innocence.
candidates.concrete_proof: The plate has visibly changed sides while the couple is still pretending it did not.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv lets the joke stay affectionate, not prosecutorial.
